statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing, self-organizing field of nested, glowing arcs that pulse and rotate in a radial pattern. The visual effect is achieved through multiple concentric rings, each rotating at different speeds and displaying colors from the visible spectrum in sharp, distinct bands. The entire composition revolves around a central glowing core, creating a hypnotic, rhythmic glow that moves independently without any viewer interaction. The use of WEBGL rendering ensures smooth 3D motion while maintaining performance within the frame budget constraints.
